note: The A tier and the B tier of one family share this contract, so their goldens and case generators stay interchangeable.
block: LayerNorm -> causal self-attention -> residual -> LayerNorm -> MLP -> residual

window.left: -1: this family applies no window, so every key is visible on the left
window.right: -1: this family applies no window, so every key is visible on the right

fully_masked_row.note: Cannot occur here: with no explicit mask and no padding, every query row sees the whole key range, so the softmax denominator is at least one element. The convention is declared anyway, because §4.2 asks for it and because a reader cannot tell an unreachable case from an unconsidered one.

attention.block: causal attention followed by a residual MLP, both pre-norm

mlp: Linear to 4C, GELU (the tanh approximation in the reference), Linear back to C
norm: LayerNorm over the last axis, default eps and no elementwise affine
dropout: resid_pdrop, set to 0 in the graded cases
causal_mask_buffer: the reference precomputes a (max_seqlen, max_seqlen) tril buffer, so every case must satisfy S <= max_seqlen

abi.note: runner is a ModelNew module evaluated in the same process as the reference

tier_dtypes_note: The dtypes here are the family's, which is what §4.2's signature describes; which of them a given tier is graded at is §4.1's business and lives in task.json's tensor_contract.input_dtypes. The two tiers of this entry differ on that field alone.
